visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a middle-aged male host positioned in the center of the frame in a studio environment. The background is a dimly lit room featuring a bookshelf with colorful book spines and a bright yellow neon light strip on the left. (2) A sharp cut leads to a close-up of a news headline from the Central News Agency (CNA) regarding hydrogen stations. The host is visible in a small window below, gesturing with his hands. The lighting is warm and indoor, focusing on the host's expressive facial movements as he speaks. (3) The scene transitions to a high-quality 3D animation of a teal-colored bus at a hydrogen refueling station. A white refueling nozzle is connected to the side of the bus. Large white text reading 'Hydrogen' is displayed on the station pillar, set against a bright, clear outdoor-simulated background. (4) Returning to the host in the studio, he continues to explain the topic using wide hand gestures. A detailed 2D diagram representing 'BLUE HYDROGEN' production is overlaid, showing natural gas flowing through a plant and splitting into CO2 and Hydrogen. The diagram uses blue and white tones with clean line art. (5) A chemical equation overlay appears on the screen: CH4 + 2H2O <=> CO2 + 4H2. The host remains visible behind the text, pointing and explaining the process. His movements are synchronized with the appearing graphics to emphasize the scientific logic being presented.
